appRole.description: The user's role within the application.

organisationId.description: The ID of the organisation the user belongs to.

organisationRole.description: The ID of the user's role within their organisation.

Organisation.title: Organisation
Organisation.description: Represents an organisation within the application.

slug.description: A URL-friendly version of the organisation name.

address.description: The physical address of the organisation.

phoneNumber.description: The contact phone number for the organisation.

abn.description: The Australian Business Number for the organisation.

primaryColor.description: The primary branding color in hex format.

accentColor.description: The accent branding color in hex format.

secondaryColor.description: The secondary branding color in hex format.

primaryLogoUrl.description: URL for the primary company logo.

secondaryLogoUrl.description: URL for the secondary company logo or icon.

subDealersEnabled.description: Indicates if the Sub Dealers module is enabled for the organisation.

parentOrganisationId.description: The ID of the parent organisation, if this is a sub-dealer.

roles.description: A list of roles within the organisation, forming a hierarchy.

id.description: A unique identifier for the role.

parent.description: The ID of the parent role. Empty for top-level roles.

permissions.description: Defines permissions for each role ID.

additionalProperties.description: A map of permission keys to boolean values.

dataWarehouseSubscriptions.description: A list of vendor IDs from the data warehouse that this organisation is subscribed to.

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description: Represents a vendor for data connection.

slug.description: A URL-friendly version of the vendor name.

dataSource.description: The source of the data connection.

primaryContact.description: Primary contact for the vendor (e.g., name, email, phone).

address.description: The physical address of the vendor.

abn.description: The Australian Business Number for the vendor.

attachmentName.description: The name of the uploaded file attachment.

attachmentUrl.description: The data URI of the uploaded file attachment.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile documents, keyed by user ID.

/organisations/{organisationId}.description: Organisation documents, keyed by a unique ID.

/data-warehouse/{vendorId}.description: Vendor documents for the data warehouse, keyed by a unique ID.
